description: Create an assignment team — a named group of members that tickets and orders can be assigned to ("create a facilities team"). Team members see assigned team work in their tasks; the first to act takes it over. Add members afterwards with add_team_member (userIds from list_members). Admin only. Not idempotent: a repeat creates a same-name twin — check list_teams before retrying after a timeout.
name: create_team
title: Create team
